items.title: 5.7 Archimedes' principle and floatation (Archimedes ka qaida aur tairna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.7 with Figs. 5.8 to 5.10 and Examples 5.2 and 5.3 (PDF 101-104).

blocks.text: Hawa se bhara ghubbara (balloon) pani ke andar chhorein to foran oopar pani ki surface (oopri satah) par aa jata hai. Lakri ka tukra pani ke andar chhorein to bhi yahi hota hai. Aap ne dekha hoga ke pani se bhara mug pani ke andar halka lagta hai, lekin pani se bahar nikalte hi bhari lagne lagta hai.

Do hazar saal se zyada pehle Yunani (Greek) scientist Archimedes ne dekha ke liquid ke andar rakhi cheez par oopar ki taraf ek force lagti hai. Is wajah se cheez ka weight kam lagta hai (apparent loss of weight, yani weight sirf kam lagta hai). Cheez par lagne wali is oopar ki force ko liquid ka upthrust kehte hain. Archimedes' principle kehta hai:

blocks.title: Archimedes' principle
blocks.text: Jab koi cheez liquid mein poori ya kuch hissa doobi ho, to us par oopar ki taraf upthrust force lagti hai jo us cheez ke hataye (displace kiye) hue liquid ke weight ke barabar hoti hai.

Ek solid cylinder lein jis ka cross-sectional area A aur oonchai h hai, aur woh liquid mein dooba hai (Fig. 5.8). Liquid ki surface se cylinder ke oopar wale face ki gehrai h₁ aur neeche wale face ki gehrai h₂ hai. To:
Agar gehrai h₁ aur h₂ par liquid ke pressure P₁ aur P₂ hon aur liquid ki density ρ ho, to:
Pressure P₁ ki wajah se liquid cylinder ke oopar wale face par force F₁ lagata hai, aur P₂ ki wajah se neeche wale face par force F₂. To:

blocks.alt: Liquid ke bartan mein oopri area A aur oonchai h ka solid cylinder poora dooba hai. Baen taraf teer gehraiyan dikhate hain: h1 oopri surface tak, h2 neeche ki surface tak, aur un ke beech h. Force F1 oopri surface par neeche aur force F2 neeche ki surface par oopar lagti hai; P1 oopri surface par pressure (dabaav) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.8: Liquid mein doobe object par upthrust hataye gaye liquid ke wazan ke barabar hai (kitab ki Figure 5.8 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche wala face zyada gehra hai (h₂ > h₁), is liye wahan pressure aur force F₂ zyada hai. Upthrust = F₂ − F₁ = ρgAh = ρgV. Kitab ki tasveer mein P₁ liquid ki surface ke paas likha hai, lekin text ke mutabiq P₁ gehrai h₁ par (cylinder ke oopar wale face par) pressure hai; is liye yahan P₁ wahin dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 5.8 mein P₁ liquid ki surface par likha hai, jabke text mein P₁ gehrai h₁ par, yani cylinder ke oopar wale face par, pressure hai. Oopar diagram mein P₁ sahi jagah dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.latex: F_1 = P_1 A = \rho g h_1 A
\text{and}\quad F_2 = P_2 A = \rho g h_2 A

blocks.text: F₁ aur F₂ cylinder ke aamne saamne faces par lagti hain (F₁ neeche ki taraf, F₂ oopar ki taraf). Is liye net (kul) force F in dono ka farq hai. Cylinder par yahi net force liquid ka upthrust hai:

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Archimedes taqreeban 287 BCE mein Sicily ke island (jazeera) par Syracuse shehar mein paida hue. Unhon ne apna mathematical kaam chhorne se inkar kiya to ek Roman sipahi ne unhen qatl kar diya.

blocks.latex: F_2 - F_1 = \rho g h_2 A - \rho g h_1 A

blocks.text: Yahan Ah cylinder ka volume V hai, jo cylinder ke hataye hue liquid ke volume ke barabar hai; is liye ρgV hataye hue liquid ka weight hai. Yeh equation dikhati hai ke liquid mein doobi cheez par upthrust lagta hai jo hataye hue liquid ke weight ke barabar hai; yahi Archimedes' principle hai.

blocks.title: Example 5.2
blocks.problem: 10 cm side wala lakri ka cube pani mein poora dubaya gaya hai. Us par pani ka upthrust nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: side L = 10 cm = 0.1 m
Pani ki density ρ = 1000 kg m⁻³; upthrust F = ?
blocks.answer: Lakri ke cube par pani ka upthrust 9.8 N hai.
